page.notes: Uncertain readings: "frustraque" and "expectabitur" are clear enough, but the "ct" ligature in "expectabitur" is worn. "ut" in "mea ut boni" is slightly blurred. The drop-cap L of "LÆtatus" is large and partly merged with the first line. "atqve" was printed with a q+v form; I rendered it as "atque" per the u/v rule. The printed "Verùm qva" was normalised to "qua". "consulas,etiam" has no space in the print and is kept as is. Page number "562" is at top left and partly worn.
